name: The App Starts When The Network Does Not Answer
note: Written with the gate on 2026-09-29 (BACKLOG FONT-1). The gate serves dist, so every mutation rebuilds.

mutations.name: the fonts go back to Google
mutations.why: The stylesheet waits on fonts.googleapis.com; on a network that holds the request open the app stays blank for as long as the connection hangs, and every launch tells Google the player's IP.

mutations.name: one bundled weight is dropped
mutations.why: Body text at that weight silently falls back to a system face; nothing else notices because the page still renders.
